def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text
def toast(title, message, kind='warning', sticky=False, next_action=False): params = {'title': ui_text(title), 'message': ui_text(message), 'type': kind, 'sticky': sticky} if next_action: params['next'] = next_action return {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': params}

return { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'name': title, 'res_model': 'hr.applicant', 'res_id': applicant.id, 'view_mode': 'form', 'views': [(False, 'form')], 'target': 'current', }
def document_complete(doc): if not doc: return False if doc.x_state != 'signed': return False
if 'x_signed_attachment_id' in doc._fields and doc.x_signed_attachment_id: return True if 'x_sign_completed_attachment_id' in doc._fields and doc.x_sign_completed_attachment_id: return True
# Legacy tolerance: some older signed rows may not have their artifact in # the newer registry attachment fields. return True
def signed_registry_map(applicant): result = {} Document = env['x_hr.recruitment_document'].sudo() docs = Document.search([ ('x_applicant_id', '=', applicant.id), ('x_document_type', 'in', [ 'board_decision', 'employment_contract', 'tor', 'policies_compliance_declaration', 'non_disclosure_agreement', ]), ], order='id desc')
for doc in docs: dtype = doc.x_document_type if dtype and dtype not in result and document_complete(doc): result[dtype] = doc
return result
def find_active_contract(applicant): if 'x_employment_contract_id' in applicant._fields and applicant.x_employment_contract_id: return applicant.x_employment_contract_id.sudo() Contract = env['x_hr.applicant_employment_contract'].sudo() return Contract.search([('x_applicant_id', '=', applicant.id)], order='id desc', limit=1)
